description: This file implements the minimax algorithm with alpha-beta pruning for a chess engine. It provides functions to evaluate positions, generate legal moves, apply moves, and choose the best move using minimax search, including tie-breaking options.

methods.name: terminalScore(position, perspective)
methods.description: Checks if the position has no legal moves indicating checkmate or stalemate and returns a terminal score (0 for draw).

methods.name: orderMoves(moves)
methods.description: Orders moves to prioritize captures for better alpha-beta pruning efficiency.

methods.name: search(position, depth, alpha, beta, maximizing, perspective)
methods.description: Performs the minimax search with alpha-beta pruning, returning the best move and its score for a given position.

methods.name: pickBestMove(position, depth, options = {})
methods.description: Public function that initiates search to select the best move for the current position and side to move, with optional tie-breaking.

ctags.name: search
ctags.pattern: /^function search(position, depth, alpha, beta, maximizing, perspective) {$/
